text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — after landing the paged-KV layout change, autotuner is picking the wrong kernel for some MQA workloads. Seeing ~20% token p50 regression for seq=512.
Sam: ugh. which kernel path is getting chosen? GQA or the paged-specific one?
Alex: It's preferring the generic fused-attn kernel instead of the paged-block-optimized one for mixed-QA shapes. Looks like the selector uses a simple bandwidth estimator that doesn't account for interleaved KV stripe locality.
Priya: Screenshot of profiler?
Alex: perf snapshot attached (excerpt):
```
Sample  | Kernel      | Time(ms)
------- | ----------- | --------
5000    | fused-attn  | 87.3
2000    | paged-attn  | 68.1
```
Also flame: fused path has higher L2 miss rate on A100 when page count>4.
Jin: Could be the seqlen-gating threshold we added last month. It uses avg-seqlen across batch, which is noisy for MQA when some requests are long. Autotuner picks lower-overhead kernel assuming short tails.
Sam: Repro steps? I'll try to run local benchmark.
Alex: repro harness in repo: infra/perf/tools/kernel_selector_bench.py — run with `--kv-layout=paged --mqa=true --batch=8 --seq-dist=mix`
Priya: I ran that quick: baseline (old selector) p50=42ms, new selector p50=51ms. Breakdown shows batching heuristics underestimating cache warmup.
perf-bot: nightly-run #kernel-selector-compare: 2073456700: regression detected: +18% p50 on mqa_paged_kv (A100-prod). Link: https://perf.redwood/compare/2073456700
Jin: Hypothesis: selector scoring uses a single scalar (estimated_bytes) and then chooses kernel with min(cost). Need to include an LRU locality factor for paged layouts: prefer paged-attn when hot-page-hit-rate < threshold.
Priya: Agree. Also we should bias the selector toward paged-attn when avg_kv_pages_per_example > 2 AND batch variance > 0.25. Quick config patch suggestion:
```
selector:
  seqlen_gate: true
  locality_bias:
    enabled: true
    kv_pages_threshold: 2
    variance_threshold: 0.25
    bias_weight: 1.2
```
Sam: I'll prototype a simple instrument that returns page_hit_rate from runtime and feed it into the autotuner's scoring function. If hit_rate low -> add penalty to fused-attn cost.
Alex: Good. Also add an A/B rollout to avoid global regressions. Canary on Dedicated pool first.
infra-bot: canary deployment scheduled: dedicated-pool-small @ 2073457000 -> 2073458600.
Priya: After adding locality bias locally I saw p50 go back to 43ms. Need unit tests for selector math + a perf test scenario with skewed seqlens.
Sam: I'll own tests and the canary. Adding TODO in PR.
Alex: Thanks — let's keep the discussion here. If someone finds other cases (sparse vs dense attention) drop them in. :thumbsup:
